design_rule: A fixed development-selected artifact is confirmed once at each declared byte budget. Every budget endpoint that can contribute to a minimum-TDL claim belongs to one joint error-control family.
candidate_artifact_rule: Before any sealed access, bind one exact generator artifact payload, recipe, implementation, dependency closure, prepared map, and real-only eligibility record to every budget slot. No candidate may be added, removed, or substituted after the first sealed access.
source_role_rule: Fit and development-selection sources are disjoint from confirmation sources by parent lineage, entity, and time; confirmation labels remain with the protected external custodian.
model_role_rule: Freeze exact model implementation, checkpoint, dependency, adapter, and auditor identities; development-selection models cannot serve as confirmation-only models unless their role is declared before exposure.
prepared_map_rule: Freeze each fit-only prepared-view mapping and its digest; share it across all generator arms for the same source/task. Query and confirmation labels cannot affect map fitting.
real_only_eligibility_rule: Confirmation sources must be rights-cleared real observational data with source lineage, split, contamination, and custody evidence. Simulated, mechanism, stress, copied, and synthetic derivatives are ineligible.

sample_policy.context: matched to real fit rows or a separately pinned declared context cap

seed_schedule.note: Fit/sample seeds are inherited as a candidate schedule. Auditor and cluster schedules remain unresolved and block freeze.

candidate_reporting_family.enumeration: One fixed development-selected artifact slot per each of the ten budget endpoints; include every endpoint in simultaneous minimum-TDL reporting, including endpoints where a selected artifact is unavailable or fails.
candidate_reporting_family.joint_error_control: Bonferroni one-sided bounds across all ten budget slots and all mandatory model/source/task contrasts; no per-budget development selection removes the across-budget family.
candidate_reporting_family.frontier_plot: Plot all ten declared budgets, all scheduled methods, and every disposition; show simultaneous intervals and mark missing/failed slots without complete-case omission.

analysis_policy.metric: TDL v2 candidate only; the active TDL contract is not frozen or certified
analysis_policy.candidate_operating_point: T90/D80 (aspirational working point; not an approved threshold)
analysis_policy.family_gate: all required family and source/task contrasts pass; no averaging away a failed required family
analysis_policy.inference: Paired source/task and query/entity-cluster design; Bonferroni simultaneous bounds; retain raw losses and all scheduled failures

privacy_outcomes.empirical_privacy: must be measured on the frozen privacy panel; absent or inconclusive is incomplete
privacy_outcomes.formal_dp: not claimed unless separately verified under its own contract

retry_exclusion_policy.failed_or_missing_attempts: retain in the denominator and report as scheduled failures
retry_exclusion_policy.retry: no retry after an exposed confirmation result; infrastructure retry only if preauthorized, bounded, same identity, and recorded as a child attempt
retry_exclusion_policy.exclusion: no outcome-dependent source, model, budget, seed, or candidate exclusions

budget_admission.note: No approved compute reservation or exact-design calibration receipt is registered.

successor_rule: Any material change after precommit requires a new version and fresh independent review before any authorized evaluation. Exposed confirmation sources are permanently marked exposed and cannot be reread as untouched.
sealed_access_rule: Deny unless every exact source, model, generator, prepared-map, metric, protocol, cache, closure, roster, privacy, budget, power, reviewer, and custodian gate is complete and independently signed.
